g.text: least privilege — every token scoped to one job
secrets out of repos — .env stays in .gitignore
zombie at :8080 — shambling, no auth header
firewall: default deny, open only what ships
passwords: long, unique, in a manager
zombie horde at :25565 — back to the spawn
logs on, alerts routed, noise tuned
